_comment: Copy this file, replace the three placeholders, pass it with --boundary-review.
sourceHash comes from the blocked run report or from the ingest JSON output.
cuts are SOURCE FRAME INDICES (integers) at which a new shot starts, taken from
decoded adjacent frames in jobs/<hash>/ingest/*/contact-sheet.html - not from the
detector scores. An interval-only reference with a single shot uses an empty array.
Every field is required; reviewer and notes must be non-empty.
notes: <what was inspected and why each cut is real, e.g. background and content change exactly at source frame 8>
